mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% (UNRATE > 4.0) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that prompt equity investors to price in recession risks, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE rising) and decrease in industrial production (INDPRO falling) signals a dual economic shock that triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy response to inflation leads to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1700 thousand units (HOUST < 1700) indicates weakening consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1700, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (RSAFS > 660000 million dollars and UNRATE < 3.5%), the economy is near its peak, leading to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 660000 and UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 104 (INDPRO < 104) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 104, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
